full_judgment: 14. The trial Court also committed error in relying upon the record of right and payment of rent which tempted it to arrive at a conclusion that Fakir Chand or his heirs lost their interest in the suit land. It is fairly established that for mere preparation of record of right without having no support of credible document one cannot claim ownership over that land. Onus of record of right is rebuttable presumption which can be rebutted by showing credible document and in the instant case the defendants have been able to show that record of right of the entire land has been wrongly prepared in the name of the plaintiffs.
